units.source_text: 今天源氏白昼到三公主处。

en.t: That day, Genji went to the Third Princess in broad daylight.

units.source_text: 他打扮得特别讲究，众侍女初次看到他这优美的打扮，尤为赞叹，庆喜自己有这个漂亮主人。

en.t: He was dressed with exceptional care, and the serving women, seeing his beautiful attire for the first time, admired him all the more and rejoiced that they had such a handsome master.

units.source_text: 只有几个年老的乳母说道：“不要太开心吧！

en.t: Only a few elderly nurses said, "Do not be too delighted!

units.source_text: 大人本人固然生得漂亮，只怕后头闹出事情来呢。”

en.t: The gentleman himself is certainly beautiful, but we fear trouble may come of it later."

units.source_text: 她们都又喜又忧。

en.t: They were all both pleased and worried.

units.source_text: 三公主生得娇小可爱。

en.t: The Third Princess was small and charming by nature.

units.source_text: 她的房间装饰得富丽堂皇，但她本人对于这些毫不关心，全无兴趣。

en.t: Her rooms were decorated with splendid magnificence, but she herself cared nothing for such things and had no interest in them at all.

units.source_text: 穿着许多衣服，身体小得几乎看不见了。

en.t: She wore many layers of clothing, and her body was so small that it was almost hidden from sight.

units.source_text: 她见了源氏并不十分羞涩，好像一个不怕生的孩子，样子亲昵可爱。

en.t: When she met Genji, she was not especially shy; like a child who did not fear strangers, she seemed affectionate and endearing.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“世人都认为朱雀院缺乏雄才大略。

en.t: Genji thought, "People all believe that the Suzaku Retired Emperor lacks great talent and broad vision.

units.source_text: 但他在风流韵事、雅兴逸趣方面，都比别人擅长。

en.t: Yet in matters of love, elegance, and refined pleasures, he is more accomplished than others.

units.source_text: 何以他教养出来的公主如此凡庸呢？

en.t: Why, then, is the princess he raised so ordinary?

units.source_text: 这三公主还是他所最心爱的女儿呢。”

en.t: And this Third Princess is the daughter he loved most dearly."

units.source_text: 他觉得遗憾，然而并不厌恶她。

en.t: He found it regrettable, yet he did not dislike her.

units.source_text: 三公主对于源氏所说的话，无不乖乖地顺从。

en.t: The Third Princess obediently followed everything Genji said.

units.source_text: 她的答话也毫无文饰，凡她知道的，无不率直地说出。

en.t: Her replies had no ornament at all; whatever she knew, she stated frankly.

units.source_text: 其天真烂漫之相，叫人怜爱不忍舍弃。

en.t: Her innocent and artless manner made one feel tender affection for her and unable to abandon her.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“倘是从前少年时代，我一定看不起这个人。

en.t: Genji thought, "If this were my younger days, I would surely have looked down on this person.

units.source_text: 但现在我对世事一视同仁，觉得这样也好，那样也好。

en.t: But now I look on worldly matters with equal eyes and feel that this way is fine and that way is fine as well.

units.source_text: 欲求出类拔萃，实乃难能之事。

en.t: To seek to be outstanding in every way is truly a difficult thing.

units.source_text: 凡长于此者，必短于彼。

en.t: Anyone who excels in one thing is sure to fall short in another.

units.source_text: 在外人想来，这三公主正是一个十全十美的人呢。”

en.t: To outsiders, this Third Princess must seem exactly like a perfectly complete person."

units.source_text: 他和紫姬多年来同栖共处，现在想来，比从前更加赞佩紫姬人品的优越了。

en.t: He had lived together with Lady Murasaki for many years, and thinking of it now, he admired the excellence of her character even more than before.

units.source_text: 可知他自己对她的教养的确有方。

en.t: This showed that his own way of raising her had indeed been skillful.

units.source_text: 于是对紫姬的爱情越发深厚起来，相别一夜，或者朝出晚归，便觉相思甚苦。

en.t: Thus his love for Lady Murasaki grew still deeper; if they were apart for a single night, or even if he left in the morning and returned at night, he felt the pain of longing keenly.

units.source_text: 何以如此钟情？

en.t: Why was he so deeply attached?

units.source_text: 自己也觉得奇怪。

en.t: He himself found it strange.
